description: Handheld phone video panning across stacks of dark padlocked metal trunks bearing white labels with the International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC) roundel emblem. One trunk is opened to reveal it packed full of banded bundles of currency resembling U.S. dollar bills. The clip circulated with claims that Red Cross shipping containers were being used to smuggle cash; the location, date, and authenticity of the scene are not shown in the video itself.
orgs: International Committee of the Red Cross
flags: Circulated with an unverified claim that the Red Cross was smuggling cash; origin, location and authenticity of the footage are not established by the video
A hand visible in one frame belongs to an unidentified private individual

description: Screenshot of the Twitter profile page for the account @Voteridplease ('Voter ID Please'), the handle tagged in President Trump’s July 30 2019 voter-ID tweet. The banner shows clasped hands of different skin tones over an American flag with the Q slogan 'Where we go one, we go all'; the avatar is a U.S. flag. The bio urges support for requiring valid ID to vote and includes #MAGA and WWG1WGA.
